kl_gradient.derivation: For each trajectory, score=action-counts minus state-visits times policy. Reverse gradient=sum p*log(p/q)*score; forward=-sum q*score; E_p(score)=0. Detached-sampling k3 gives sum(p-q)*score, hence forward. k1 and fully-detached give zero. Misnormalized reverse divides by three in every fixture.
